auditor_value: F_min = μmg/(cosθ + μ sinθ) = mg sinφ / cos(θ − φ), option (a)

findings.quote: a vertical part that lifts it slightly, reducing the normal force from the surface
findings.note: The block does not rise; the upward component F sinθ carries part of the weight so the surface pushes less. 'Lifts it slightly' suggests motion off the surface that does not happen.
findings.fix: a vertical part that supports part of the block's weight, reducing the normal force from the surface

notes: Independently: N = mg − F sinθ, F cosθ = μN, F = μmg/(cosθ + μ sinθ); with μ = tanφ this is mg sinφ/(cosθ cosφ + sinθ sinφ) = mg sinφ/cos(θ − φ) — sympy confirms the two forms are identical. Both common_mistakes entries are genuine: option (d) mg sinφ is the minimum over θ (at θ = φ), and option (b) is the sinφ/cosφ swap.
